steps.speaker: Mira
steps.title: Welcome Back
steps.body:
You made it back in one piece — and with loot to show for it! See the buildings around town? Each one is a facility run by a specialist who can put your haul to good use.

Click any building on the map or use the nav buttons on the left to open a facility.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.title: Put Your Loot to Work
steps.body:
The Blacksmith, Huntsman, and Enchanter unlock new equipment recipes for the Shop — bring them materials and they'll expand what's available to buy. If you need a specific piece of gear, you can also place a craft request directly — it costs extra, but you'll get exactly what you're after.

The Training Hall teaches your heroes new classes as you unlock regions. And the Alchemist and Chef let you mix ingredients into potions and food.
